text: Steenbarger: one trigger, in_zone:ma_20 on D, the word raschke also named: buy the pullback into the 20-day average while `elder` stays 7 or more (C6, C10). Not close_above:pivot_high: `subcomponents.energy.en_pos50` 91.5 is the range top and `elder` 10.0 is summer (C20). wrong_if: `elder` prints 1 or less (red, C3), or weekly EMA9 crosses under EMA21, or a daily close under ma_50. Regime: valid only while the weekly tide is up, `subcomponents.structure.wk_score` 15.0 (C21). Name SUPPORT; the pivot trigger clears only after a pullback into ma_20 has printed.
